title: Nested Container Frames
concept: Lugwork, a fictional two-person steel bicycle frame workshop in Ghent: a 1320 px outer frame with full-height hairlines and square corner markers at every band seam, level-2 panels inset by one shared gap (blue hero with a coral pinwheel bloom, paper process panel, white model frames, cobalt proof, blue CTA), and level-3 modules inset again — a live build sheet with tabbed geometry drawings and a fitting-slot form.
notes: Three levels only (outer frame → inset panel → one inset module), with hairline dividers instead of further boxes. The bloom is a CSS repeating-conic-gradient, masked and blurred, rotating slowly; reduced motion stops it and the frame draw-in. Geometry SVGs are generated in the page frontmatter. Photos from Unsplash; the form only confirms locally.
